# Statista

> Statista is a leading global statistics portal providing market data, research, and analysis across 60,000+ topics from 22,500+ sources.

Statista offers comprehensive industry overviews, market forecasts, and trending statistics across technology, e-commerce, finance, healthcare, media, and society sectors. The platform serves as a primary resource for business intelligence, market analysis, and data-driven decision-making with coverage of major companies like Apple, Microsoft, Netflix, Amazon, and regional markets including the United States, Europe, China, and India.

## Key Topics

- Market Research
- Market Analysis
- Business Intelligence
- Digital Transformation
- E-Commerce
- Consumer Behavior
- Global Statistics
- Industry Analysis
- Market Data
- Social Media
- Technology & Telecommunications
- Finance & Insurance
- Healthcare & Pharma
- Sustainability
- Trending Statistics

## Core Platform

- [Statista Homepage](https://www.statista.com): Leading statistics portal with 22,500+ sources, 60,000+ topics
- [Industry Overview Directory](https://www.statista.com/markets): Industry overview directory organizing market data by sector classification
- [Topic Overview Directory](https://www.statista.com/topics): Topic directory: 60,000+ topics including elections, sports, technology, global data

## Market Sectors

- [Technology & Telecommunications](https://www.statista.com/markets/418/technology-telecommunications): Technology & Telecommunications sector statistics: Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia, Google
- [E-Commerce](https://www.statista.com/markets/413/e-commerce): E-commerce market overview: eBay, Etsy, Taobao, B2B/B2C/C2C commerce data
- [Internet](https://www.statista.com/markets/424/internet): Internet market overview: e-commerce, social media, mobile internet statistics
- [Media](https://www.statista.com/markets/417/media): Media industry overview: Spotify, Netflix, Amazon, Disney streaming platforms
- [Finance & Insurance](https://www.statista.com/markets/414/finance-insurance): Finance & Insurance sector: institutions, investments, services, market statistics
- [Health, Pharma & Medtech](https://www.statista.com/markets/412/health-pharma-medtech): Health, Pharma & Medtech sector: pharmaceutical market, medical technology, healthcare
- [Transportation & Logistics](https://www.statista.com/markets/419/transportation-logistics): Transportation & Logistics sector: aviation, rail, autonomous vehicles, decarbonization
- [Consumer Goods & FMCG](https://www.statista.com/markets/415/consumer-goods-fmcg): Consumer goods & FMCG market analysis: trends, sustainability, digital innovation
- [Economy & Politics](https://www.statista.com/markets/2535/economy-politics): Economy & Politics sector: GDP, employment, government finances, economic indicators
- [Society](https://www.statista.com/markets/411/society): Society sector overview: demographics, education, crime, law enforcement statistics

## Market Forecasts & Global Data

- [Global AI Market Size Forecast 2031](https://www.statista.com/forecasts/1474143/global-ai-market-size): Global AI market size forecast 2026-2031: US, EU, China, South Korea projections
- [Social Media Users Worldwide 2030](https://www.statista.com/forecasts/278414/number-of-worldwide-social-network-users): Global social media users forecast 2030: Facebook, WhatsApp, Telegram, demographics
- [Global Retail E-Commerce Sales 2022-2028](https://www.statista.com/statistics/379046/worldwide-retail-e-commerce-sales): Global e-commerce sales 2022-2028: Amazon, Walmart, regional trends, B2C retail
- [Internet and Social Media Users Worldwide 2025](https://www.statista.com/statistics/617136/digital-population-worldwide): Internet users 2025: global digital demographics, penetration rates, regional usage
- [Global Data Growth Forecast 2029](https://www.statista.com/statistics/871513/worldwide-data-created): Global data growth forecast 2029: zettabytes, big data trends, creation statistics

## Trending & Popular Statistics

- [Recent Statistics](https://www.statista.com/statistics/recent): Recent statistics dashboard: trending data on social media, apps, consumer behavior
- [Popular Statistics](https://www.statista.com/statistics/popular): Popular statistics: social media, COVID-19, sports, trending topics, data visualization
